paper.title_en: Coherent Recovery of Nested Codes over the Quantum Erasure Channel Using Erasure Decoding and Quantization
paper.abstract_en: Motivated by quantum capacity results, we revisit nested binary linear codes for the quantum erasure channel through a packing-covering viewpoint: the outer code supports erasure reconstruction, while the inner code performs erasure quantization. We turn this perspective into two explicit decoder architectures. Architecture I requires no stabilizer-syndrome measurements and combines a classical peeling decoder and erasure quantizer with corresponding coherent quantum reconstruction and cleanup operations that disentangle the logical state from inaccessible erasure-environment branches. Architecture II goes one step further and implements erasure belief propagation directly through reversible ternary quantum gates, providing quantum state healing that reconstructs erased symbols while leaving unerased code states unperturbed. We establish sufficient conditions for exact recovery of arbitrary logical states, and illustrate both architectures using the Steane code, including explicit scheduling procedures and coherent quantum circuits.
